Question: What is Sonorius and how does it help preparation?
Answer: Sonorius is an offline-first, voice-assisted study and rehearsal platform. You can practice actively with a custom think-time pause to articulate your answers out loud before the saved answer plays, or listen continuously without pauses while reviewing architecture diagrams. Everything runs 100% locally on your machine with zero cloud telemetry, ensuring your questions and study notes remain completely private.

Question: How do I create a custom practice playlist in Sonorius?
Answer: Navigate to 'Manage Playlists' in the sidebar navigation. In the 'Create New Playlist' section, type a playlist name (e.g., 'System Architecture'), then choose questions directly from the scrollable vault checklist. You can filter questions in real-time or select all with one click. Below the checklist, customize the playback sequence order in the numbered table and click 'Save Playlist' to store it in your local SQLite database.

Question: How can I add a new question with an architecture diagram or visual aid?
Answer: Go to 'Add New Q&A' from the sidebar navigation. Type in your question prompt and your curated reference answer. You can optionally attach an architecture diagram, wireframe, or screenshot in PNG, JPEG, or WebP format. Sonorius automatically verifies file magic bytes, strips unnecessary metadata, and re-encodes the image securely so it renders cleanly below the question and answer cards during practice.

Question: How does the two-voice dialogue work?
Answer: In the sidebar under 'Preferences', Sonorius allows you to configure a two-voice dialogue. You can assign one voice to the Interviewer (who reads the questions) and a different voice to the Candidate (who reads your curated answers). This creates an engaging dialogue instead of a monotone monologue.

Question: How do I adjust Think Time pauses?
Answer: Open the 'Preferences' panel in the sidebar and adjust 'Think Time (Pause between Q & A)'. Set Think Time from 1s up to 120s (2 minutes) for active speaking practice, giving you time to speak your response out loud before hearing your saved answer. Set Think Time to 0s to listen to questions and answers continuously back-to-back without any pause.

Question: How does the Play Session player work?
Answer: When you launch a playlist in 'Play Session', Sonorius stitches high-fidelity audio while presenting the current Question card, Answer card, and visual diagram on screen. You can browse cards forwards and backwards with Previous/Next controls without interrupting playback, adjust speech speed from 0.75x to 1.35x, or click 'Stop Practice (Unfreeze)' at any time to unlock vault editing.

Question: How does Sonorius protect my personal data, questions, and privacy?
Answer: Sonorius is engineered with a strict local-first security architecture: all questions, answers, and playlist mappings reside in a local SQLite database with strict file permissions (0o600). By default, the Kokoro TTS engine connects strictly over loopback (localhost), and the final stitched session audio is assembled in memory, while individual speech clips are cached locally in audio_cache/ with owner-only permissions (0o600) and can be removed at any time with Clear Audio Cache. No external servers or cloud APIs ever receive your study materials.
